result.title: Darwin-Claw: Environment-Adaptive Experience Consolidation for Recursively Self-Evolving Agents
result.summary: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across complex tasks, they predominantly operate in isolated sessions, lacking the ability to continually learn from historical interactions or adapt to user-specific environments. Existing self-evolution paradigms often indiscriminately inject raw interaction trajectories into memory or skill modules, leading to obscured behavioral patterns and compromised update controllability. Furthermore, as foundational LLM reasoning improves, the bottleneck for agentic evolution shifts from accumulating generic knowledge to effectively managing situational experience. To address this, we propose Darwin-Claw, an environment-adaptive self-evolving framework that systematically distills episodic experiences to drive the comprehensive evolution of operational skills and durable memory. Theoretically grounded in an iterative agent-actor and evolver-critic co-adaptation, Darwin-Claw introduces a Hierarchical Experience Consolidation System that extracts fine-grained error attributions and generalizes them into dynamically updated prototype vectors. This structured situational experience serves as interaction patches for context-sensitive perception and explicit optimization signals for skill refinement. Practically, Darwin-Claw is a readily deployable, automated framework compatible with mainstream agent systems without requiring manual curation. Extensive experiments on WildClawBench demonstrate that Darwin-Claw yields substantial performance improvements, establishing a controllable and stable pathway for the continual, user-centric adaptation of autonomous agents in real-world ecosystems.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Darwin-Claw 这一环境自适应智能体自演化框架：用分层经验整合系统从交互片段中抽取细粒度错误归因，并泛化为动态更新的原型向量，以此驱动操作技能与长期记忆的持续演化，并在 WildClawBench 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作把交互轨迹归因、压缩为原型向量并当作显式优化信号，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的轨迹训练、贡献分配与状态抽象提供可供核查的方法线索，但研究场景是文本智能体的记忆与技能演化，与视觉推理主线无直接联系。
